supported.claim: The four gradient outputs from dVdQ_hc are unpacked but not used by objective_fun's f1-f4 computation.
E3a recorded 66 returned rows, 1,501,500 objective evaluations, zero reported selected/all-four/final-F nonfinite counts; all 1,501,500 calls observed dVdQ_hc return.
The selected sources support explaining gradient warnings as a plausible source without modifying fixed util bytes or repeating E3a.

findings.problem: Exclusive attribution of all recorded warnings to discarded gradient arrays and categorical no-impact claim exceed available records. _WarnCount receives filename/lineno but retains only category/message; the hook spans the entire optimizer call, not only objective_fun/dVdQ_hc. Stderr records numpy gradient internals but does not bind each grouped warning or its caller; prepare/load_inputs performs extract_battery_data outside that hook.
findings.fix: State separately: four gradient values are not consumed by objective f1-f4; recorded objective nonfinite counts are zero; discarded gradients plausibly explain warnings but exclusive provenance is not established. Preserve no convergence/scientific fitting claim. No new E3a execution is needed to narrow prose.

findings.problem: The E3a record-only warning policy cannot be transplanted as-is without a C4-A classification/storage contract. H uses COBYQA and J_V/J_D/rho/J_Vs paths; its existing local runner stores every warning in memory before deduplication, unlike E3a's bounded counter. Unknown solver options must remain structural stops.
findings.fix: Add warning-class policy and bounded storage/counting with overflow handling to implementation-request deliverables and dataless tests. Preserve existing unknown-options/structural-error/nonfinite-witness handling. Do not claim C4-A will have identical warning counts or that all future warnings are merely informational.
findings.limitation: This is an explicit implementation requirement, not an already-observed C4-A runtime failure or request to rerun E3a.

suggested_KO: 고정 util의 dVdQ_hc가 반환하는 기울기 배열 넷은 objective_fun의 f1–f4 계산에 사용되지 않으며, E3a 기록상 1,501,500회 평가의 목적값 비유한 수는 0이다. 이 경로는 경고의 유력한 설명이지만 기존 집계가 호출 위치를 보존하지 않아 모든 경고의 원인을 확정하지 않는다. C4-A의 경고 분류·유한 저장·비유한 판정 및 기존 중지 조건은 별도 구현 명세로 결속한다. util 원본과 기존 E3a 수용을 유지하며 새 조사 실행은 요구하지 않는다.
